NOTE TO MANUFACTURERS: I NEVER SEND EMAILS ASKING FOR REVIEW SAMPLES

I started vaping in March of 2014, in fact, the very first video I made is still on the channel.  Vaping helped me get off the cigarettes and ultimately helped me a lot with my health.

This channel reviews everything to do with e-cigs.  The difference between this channel and a lot of other's out there is that you can be assured that the item I am reviewing on the video has been used for at least a week or more.  I have a reputation of being honest when it comes to the reviews and I am NOT a "promoter" which some reviewers have turned into.  You can see it in the comments that people purchase their next e-cig based on my full review, which is why in 2016/17 and 18 I was voted the no.1 e-cig reviewer in the UK by popular vote on EcigClickUK.

Enquiries?  Head over to http://www.vapingwithvic.co.uk and use the "Review Request" page.
